mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id, p.user_id, u.nickname, p.cert_id, p.category, p.title, p.content, p.view_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.post_id = #{postId}
